lines.text: All Israel gathers to David at Hebron and reminds him that the LORD said he would shepherd His people.
The elders come to David at Hebron, where he makes a sacrifice, and they anoint him king.
David and Israel march to Jerusalem, also called Jebus, and David captures the fortress of Zion despite the Jebusites' warning.
David promises that whoever first strikes down a Jebusite becomes chief commander, and Abishai son of Zeruiah goes up first.
David lives in the fortress, builds up the city, and grows greater because the LORD of Hosts is with him.
